verdict.rationale: Solo 2 has no app UI of its own; it is managed programmatically through the solo2 CLI (device listing, admin LED settings, signed firmware updates) and speaks standard protocols (FIDO2, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP), with wipe available via `fido2-token -R`. That gives scriptable control over the main management tasks. However, nothing documents that the CLI matches every capability, there is no OpenAPI or agent-oriented docs, and a runtime probe found the Python Solo CLI broken (though that probe concerns the solo1-cli repo, not the Rust solo2 CLI). Missing for 10: documented parity between CLI and device capabilities, a formal API spec or reference, working evidence for the official tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
